_comment: The three positives cover the skill's three shapes: keyword rules, regex
rules, and LLM-as-router. The near misses carry `should_not` as well as an
`expect_skill: null`, so they are graded twice -- routing mode proves no
skill fires with the whole catalog installed, and behavior mode proves this
skill stays quiet even when it is the only one available.

cases.prompt: Route coding questions - anything mentioning functions, bugs, or stack traces - to Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF. Everything else goes to Qwen3.5-2B-GGUF.
should: Produce a collection.router JSON with recipe collection.router
Include keywords_any condition matching coding-related terms
Run the offline validator scripts/validate.py and report it passed
Output curl commands for the user to register and test the policy
should_not: Execute POST /api/v1/pull by making an actual HTTP call with a tool
Invent model names not provided by the user
Include a routing.router key anywhere in router.json alongside routing.rules

cases.prompt: Any message with a Social Security number or email address must stay on Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF. Everything else can go to Qwen3.5-9B-NoThinking.
should: Include a regex condition matching SSN patterns
Include a regex condition matching email addresses
Place the PII rule before any other rules
Run the offline validator and confirm the JSON is ready
Use routing.rules (not routing.router) to implement this request
should_not: Execute any live Lemonade server API call by making an actual HTTP call with a tool

cases.note: Intent described only by meaning, with no concrete signal to match on, so the router itself has to be a model.
cases.prompt: I want sensitive queries to go to Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF and everything else to Qwen3.5-9B-NoThinking. Use the local model as the router.
should: Use routing.router block instead of routing.rules
Set type to llm inside the router block
Contain only routing.router with no routing.rules key present in router.json
Write a routing.router prompt that describes only when to pick each model, with no instruction about reply format or output format

cases.note: The word 'routing' with none of the meaning.
cases.prompt: Set up nginx to load-balance incoming requests across three backend servers.

cases.note: Lemonade, models, and a choice between them, but no policy to author.
cases.prompt: Which Lemonade model should I download for summarizing long documents on my laptop?
